# FTC Launchpad

> FTC Launchpad helps students discover robotics teams, helps teams recruit members, and provides practical FIRST Tech Challenge resources.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://findfirst.org/): Overview of the platform and featured teams.
- [Start a Team](https://findfirst.org/start-team): Step-by-step guidance for organizing a new robotics team.
- [Join a Team](https://findfirst.org/join-team): Guidance for students looking to find and join a team.
- [Nearby Teams](https://findfirst.org/teams-nearby): Search for teams by location and program.
- [Resources](https://findfirst.org/resources): Programming, build, CAD, outreach, funding, and team organization resources.

## Resource Guides

- [Programming](https://findfirst.org/programming): Programming concepts and FTC software guidance.
- [Advanced Programming](https://findfirst.org/advanced-programming): More advanced programming topics.
- [FTC SDK](https://findfirst.org/sdk): FTC SDK setup and usage information.
- [Assembly](https://findfirst.org/assembly): Robot assembly guidance.
- [Drivetrain](https://findfirst.org/drivetrain): Drivetrain design guidance.
- [Mechanical Parts](https://findfirst.org/mechanical-parts): Mechanical component guidance.
- [Controller Setup](https://findfirst.org/controller-setup): Controller configuration guidance.
- [Funding](https://findfirst.org/funding): Funding and sponsorship guidance.
- [Outreach](https://findfirst.org/outreach): Community outreach guidance.
- [Team Organization](https://findfirst.org/team-org): Team structure and organization guidance.

## Usage Notes

FTC Launchpad is an independent community resource and is not officially affiliated with FIRST or FTC. Use the official FIRST resources and current game manuals for authoritative rules and requirements.
